name: anonymous-app
description: Aplicação web ANONYMOUS - Q&A anônimo com monetização

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python src/main.py
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && pip freeze > requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/
scripts.seed: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python scripts/seed.py
scripts.migrate: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python scripts/migrate.py
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:production
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && gunicorn -w 4 -b 0.0.0.0:5000 src.main:app
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.clean: rm -rf frontend/node_modules frontend/dist backend/venv backend/__pycache__ backend/src/__pycache__
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && flake8 src/ tests/

author: Manus AI
